answer_2.quote: We use n-gram overlap based BLEU-4 and more recent neural evaluation metric BERTScore to measure performance by comparing the generated response to the ground truth. Retrieval metrics like recall@k (k = {1,5,10}), mean rank, and mean reciprocal rank are used.
